notes.title: New Challenge Update!
notes.content:
What's New?
[list]
[*]🧗 A New Difficult Climb – Brace yourself for an intense new ascent featuring fresh obstacles, strong winds, and plenty of ways to fall all the way back down.

[*]🎶 New Music – Immerse yourself in the climb with brand-new tracks that perfectly capture the "I'm about to lose my mind" experience.

[*]🏆 5 New Achievements – Because nothing says "suffering" like more achievements to grind for. Will you be among the few who unlock them all?

[*]🔥 More Rage Moments – Fails, falls, and heartbreaking resets await. If you thought the original climb tested your patience, this update takes things to a whole new level.
[/list]

Get ready to climb, fall, rage, and (maybe) conquer. Let us know what you think in the comments, and don’t forget to share your most spectacular fails!😂
See you at the top… or the bottom.

- RAZE GAMES
